purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded access review; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The official Darbhanga District Administration land-records page links the Bihar Bhumi land-record service. Bihar Revenue and Land Records Directorate provides an official public BhuNaksha cadastral-map viewer with district/subdivision/circle/mauza/map-sheet selectors, and Government of India DILRMP publishes Darbhanga district cadastral-map status. These establish local district land-record/map services, but the city-centroid village and a full-vector endpoint are not verified. The anonymous official BhuNaksha viewer exposes raster WMS display and plot-identification workflows, not a verified full-vector polygon feed. No feature query or geometry sample was made because the client did not identify a vector route or safe response schema.

officialEvidence.observation: Official district land-records page links to Bihar Bhumi and is owned by the Darbhanga District Administration (last updated 2026-09-26).
Anonymous official Bihar BhuNaksha shell displays selectors for district, subdivision, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance, and sheet. No feature geometry was requested.
Official viewer client renders map layers as WMS images and calls plot identification after a village/GIS selection. No full-vector polygon route was found in the client.
Official Bihar Directorate of Land Records and Survey lists Bhu-Naksha and Online Map among public services.
Government of India DILRMP district report for Darbhanga publishes cadastral map, village, and parcel digitization status.

viewer.observation: Public cadastral-map selector; current client uses WMS and plot selection. District has official map digitization status, but no city-point selector, full geometry schema, or anonymous vector service was verified.

serviceTrace.notes: The WUP point is not resolved to a specific Darbhanga mauza, and district map counts do not demonstrate complete city-center coverage.
